title: FAA UAP reports, batch 22 (237UAP00589 - 237UAP00613)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA UAP reports from air traffic control logs; most entries are distant sightings, but one report describes a close-range encounter with a physical object.

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a silver, business-jet-sized object less than 1,000 feet above their aircraft.
encounters.entity_appearance: silver, size of a small business jet
encounters.quote: silver in color and the size of a small business jet
